steps.heading: A Series is values plus a label
steps.body: Every Series pairs an array of values with an index and an optional name. Pulling a column out of a DataFrame (df['revenue']) gives you exactly this: the values, the shared row index, and the column name.

steps.heading: Custom labels
steps.caption: The index doesn't have to be numbers, it can be anything meaningful.

steps.heading: Aligned arithmetic, and per-element transforms
steps.body: Arithmetic between two Series lines up by index first, then computes, not just by position. map()/apply() transform every element with a lookup or a function; unique()/value_counts() summarize what's actually in a column.

steps.heading: A derived difference
steps.caption: You'll practice renaming, converting, mapping, and aggregating Series values in the cards that follow.
